title: Cute Home in Waco for Sale
description:
Oh! This is the house for you. Classic 1940s and contemporary 2000s meet to give you a beautiful home. This 2 bedroom 1 bath house is the perfect for the newlyweds or the single person. You are just off Bosque Blvd which puts you at Extraco Events Center or shopping in minutes. A green space at the end of Springdale St would be a great play space for the fur babies. The young couple that owns it now loves it so much. They wish they didn't have to sell but life has other plans. They worked on the bones of the house as well as the aesthetics of the home. Both the plumbing and AC were completely renovated in 2022.

This house is not just a place to live but a home to persevere. Relaxing in the living room will give you the warm history of a home, place, and time. Enjoy the dining room, which overlooks the backyard, where eating is an event, not just a physical must. The backyard is a place of peace, where birds and wildlife will converge with you to share life. Can you smell grandmother's cookie recipe come to life? Only if you decide that it is time for you to live at 1413 Springdale.

Find out more at: https://www.homes.com/property/1413-springdale-st-waco-tx/cv66q2jzgq9lm/
